raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

- Disable `RowWiseTorchFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel` on RDNA4 (`gfx1200` and `gfx1201`).
- Preserve the existing RowWise path for other ROCm architectures.

## Motivation

Fixes #57838. vLLM 0.28+ began selecting the RowWise Torch FP8 scaled-MM kernel on RDNA4, where the issue reporter measured lower decode throughput than the ChannelWise kernel. The support gate now rejects RDNA4 so normal kernel selection can fall through to ChannelWise.

## Why This Is Not Duplicating Existing Work

Before opening this PR, I checked issue #57838 comments and searched open PRs for both `57838` and `RDNA4 RowWise FP8`. The issue has no assignee and no open PR addresses this fix.

## Testing

- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/kernels/quantization/test_scaled_mm_kernel_selection.py -v`
  - 10 passed
- `.venv/bin/ruff check --ignore ISC004 vllm/model_executor/kernels/linear/scaled_mm/pytorch.py tests/kernels/quantization/test_scaled_mm_kernel_selection.py`
  - passed
- `.venv/bin/ruff format --check vllm/model_executor/kernels/linear/scaled_mm/pytorch.py tests/kernels/quantization/test_scaled_mm_kernel_selection.py`
  - passed
- `git diff --check`
  - passed

The full pre-commit environment could not be initialized because the configured package mirror failed TLS connection setup.

## Benchmark

No RDNA4 GPU is available in the local test environment, so no new hardware throughput benchmark was run. The issue report contains the hardware measurements motivating this change: 32.22 tok/s with RowWise versus 35.45 tok/s with ChannelWise on the same setup.

## AI Assistance

AI assistance was used to investigate, implement, and test this change. The human submitter reviewed every changed line and confirmed the relevant test results before opening this PR.

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("is_rdna4", [True, False])
+def test_rowwise_torch_fp8_scaled_mm_rdna4_support(
+    is_rdna4: bool, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(pytorch_scaled_mm.current_platform, "is_rocm", lambda: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        pytorch_scaled_mm, "_supports_torch_fp8_scaled_mm", lambda: True
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        pytorch_scaled_mm,
+        "_rocm_rowwise_fp8_scaled_mm_slower_on_rdna4",
+        lambda: is_rdna4,
+    )
+
+    supported, reason = RowWiseTorchFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel.is_supported()
+
+    assert supported is not is_rdna4
+    if is_rdna4:
+        assert reason == "is slower than ChannelWise on RDNA4."
+    else:
+        assert reason is None
+
